pending_interview.category: Case/product sense — client scoping walkthroughs, articulating tradeoffs out loud, build-vs-buy reasoning
pending_interview.question: A large consumer packaged goods (CPG) company — think a brand that sells household products through major retailers — comes to you saying they want to build a "first-party data strategy." They currently have no CRM, their customer data lives in three disconnected point-of-sale systems run by different retail partners, and they have a loyalty app with about 200,000 monthly active users. Their VP of Marketing wants to be using a data clean room within six months to do campaign measurement with a major streaming platform. How do you scope this engagement, what do you tell them about sequencing, and where would you push back on their stated timeline or approach?
